heading: Next Week at Town Hall
body:
On Monday, September 28, the Select Board will hold a hybrid meeting at 7:00 p.m. featuring presentations on the Boxborough Climate Action Plan adoption, Abatement Fee increases, and State Election and Fall Town Meeting warrants.

[Click here](https://www.boxborough-ma.gov/AgendaCenter/Search/?term=&CIDs=all&startDate=09/24/2026&endDate=10/02/2026&dateRange=&dateSelector=) for a list of all agendas for the upcoming week, including Zoom links. Visit [boxborough-ma.gov](https://www.boxborough-ma.gov) for other calendar and agenda items.
